title: Act Schema
description: A verb - an action LORE cares about (the dynamic primitive; the reaction that changes state). Subkind `event` = an act that carries a `trigger` describing a temporal occurrence. Accountability (CORE-INVARIANT 13): an act whose `effect` is `destructive` or `external` (risky/permanent) MUST name an `accountable` principal - and per invariant 13 that accountable party must ultimately be a human. Enforced by lore_validate.py Check 4.

actor.description: object-ref id of the principal performing the act.

action.description: the verb, e.g. approve, revoke, import, create.

subject.description: object-ref id of what the act is upon.

effect.description: risk class; destructive/external require an accountable principal (invariant 13).

accountable.description: object-ref id of the accountable (human) principal; required for destructive/external effects.

trigger.description: required when subkind=event: what temporal occurrence triggered the act.
